quotes.text: broad coverage is not the same as operational fitness. A system that can attempt every task is not a system that should own every task
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up why one generalist bot should not own every enterprise task.

quotes.text: Even if your own workload lands differently, the direction is clear. Better routing changes the bill, more than endless prompt tuning on the wrong model.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear recommendation to fix AI costs through routing instead of prompt tweaking.

quotes.text: An average model with tight permissions is easier to contain than an excellent model with broad access and vague tool rights.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Puts least privilege ahead of model quality as the key control in multi-agent systems.

quotes.text: do not confuse a control plane with a complete design. A control plane can tell you what exists, constrain what is allowed, and help you stop unsafe things faster.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sets realistic expectations for what Agent 365 can and cannot do.

quotes.text: Emergence is not a prompt problem. It is a system problem. And if the risk is systemic, the answer cannot live only inside isolated prompts.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why emergent multi-agent risk needs system-level controls such as chain limits and kill switches.

takeaways: A single generalist copilot running every request on a premium model creates cost, quality and governance debt; a governed fabric of bounded experts fits enterprise work better.
Make a cheap, structured router the first expert, use small models for routine traffic and escalate to premium reasoning or human review only on clear confidence, ambiguity and risk triggers.
Let Copilot Studio own the user experience and Foundry own model control, and govern the fabric with Agent 365, Azure Policy model allow lists, traces and named owners.
hook: Most teams build one copilot on one big model and wonder why costs rise, answers blur and governance gets messy. This episode is for architects and AI platform owners on the Microsoft stack. It shows how to replace the generalist bot with a governed mixture of experts, with small-model routing, Copilot Studio and Foundry roles, escalation logic and Agent 365 governance.
